candidates.source: \x01CK, an accomplished holy warrior of Elmal, comes to your clan looking for your aid in a great heroquest. “Our people are cursed by fighting and dissension. Hendriki fight Heortlanders. People in Dragon Pass squabble. Differences are more important than similarities. I wish to go to the realm of the gods, so that Orlanth may fight me. Then people will be loyal and united again. I need your magic to help me.”
candidates.translation: \x01CK是一位成就卓著的埃尔马尔圣武士，他来到你的氏族，寻求你协助一场伟大的英雄探索。“我们的人民受争斗与不和之咒所困。亨德里基人同赫奥特兰人厮杀。龙隘的人争吵不休。分歧比共同点更重要。我愿前往诸神领域，让奥兰斯与我一战。那样人们便会再次忠诚团结。我需要你的魔法助我。”

candidates.source: The Elmali holy warrior \x01CK approached us, seeking our support for his heroquest.
candidates.translation: 埃尔马尔圣武士\x01CK走近我们，寻求我们支持他的英雄探索。

candidates.source: Do as \x01CK asks.
candidates.translation: 照\x01CK说的做。

candidates.source: \x01CK was pleased; he said that we spared him the necessity of approaching other clans, too.
candidates.translation: \x01CK很高兴；他说我们让他连去联络其他氏族的必要都免了。

candidates.source: The other clans refused us. \x01CK departed, swearing gore-spattered vengeance on the cowards in Dragon Pass who did not understand the need for unity between Orlanthi.
candidates.translation: 其他氏族拒绝了我们。\x01CK离开了，发誓要向龙隘那些不明白奥兰斯人之间需要团结的懦夫报以血淋淋的复仇。

candidates.source: \x01CK flew into a rage, claiming we were liars.
candidates.translation: \x01CK勃然大怒，说我们是骗子。

candidates.source: \x01CK flew into a rage. “You lie! Your magic is strong. I can feel it like metal on the back of my tongue! You have the magic, yet you will not give it to me! No one will give it to me!”
candidates.translation: \x01CK勃然大怒。“你撒谎！你们的魔法很强。我能感觉到它，就像舌根上压着金属！你们有魔法，却不肯给我！没有人肯给我！”

candidates.source: \x01CK flew into a rage, insulting our magic and leaving without enjoying our hospitality.
candidates.translation: \x01CK勃然大怒，辱骂我们的魔法，没享用我们的款待就离开了。

candidates.source: \x01CK flew into a rage. “You stinking Dragon Pass folk are all alike! Boastful and proud, yet without a piss-pot’s worth of magic between the lot of you!” He stalked out of the hall without touching the lavish meal we had prepared for him.
candidates.translation: \x01CK勃然大怒。“你们这些臭烘烘的龙隘人全都一个样！自吹自擂、狂妄自大，可你们所有人凑一块儿，魔法加起来还装不满一个尿壶！”他大步走出大厅，碰都没碰我们为他准备的丰盛饭食。

candidates.source: “Your idea is foolish, \x01CK.”
candidates.translation: “你的想法很愚蠢，\x01CK。”

candidates.source: If we enlist our neighbors and \x01CK succeeds, they will be grateful. If he fails, they will blame us for involving them.
candidates.translation: 如果我们争取到邻族，而\x01CK成功了，他们会感激我们。如果他失败，他们会怪我们把他们牵扯进来。

candidates.source: If helping \x01CK robs us of our fertility for the year, we have enough stored food to get by.
candidates.translation: 如果帮助\x01CK会夺走我们这一年的丰产之力，我们储存的食物也足够度日。

candidates.source: If helping \x01CK robs us of our fertility for the year, we will starve.
candidates.translation: 如果帮助\x01CK会夺走我们这一年的丰产之力，我们就会挨饿。

candidates.source: \x01CK has quite a temper. I doubt he will be able to reconcile anyone.
candidates.translation: \x01CK脾气不小。我怀疑他谁都调解不了。

candidates.source: \x01CK has not come back from his heroquest. We must assume he was destroyed in the realm of the gods. This is bad news for us all; the magic we gave him is lost forever, and can’t be used to fatten our livestock or protect our crops.
candidates.translation: \x01CK没有从他的英雄探索中归来。我们只能认为他已毁于诸神领域。这对我们所有人都是坏消息；我们交给他的魔法永远失落了，再也不能用来让牲畜长膘或保护庄稼。

candidates.source: Divorces are not uncommon in Orlanthi society. What is uncommon is the screaming rancor that marks the divorce of \x01CO and \x01CP. \x01CP, who is kin to several ring members of the \x01@! clan, insists that \x01CO return her dowry — the exact ten cows she brought with her. candidates.translation: 我们在\x01EH的坟前举行仪式，恳求他的还魂尸在来世加入我们受敬重的祖先之列，不再骚扰家人。坟墓咕哝了几声，随后归于寂静。那天夜里，\x01EH留在了地下，他的家人几周来第一次安安稳稳地吃了一顿晚饭。

candidates.source: ancestors to admit \x01EH’s spirit into their hall.
candidates.translation: 祖先接纳\x01EH的灵魂进入他们的殿堂。

candidates.source: \x01EH’s family were saddened, but understood our ancestors’ point of view. “The pig stories are the worst,” they said.
candidates.translation: \x01EH的家人虽然难过，但理解我们祖先的看法。“关于猪的故事最糟糕了，”他们说。

candidates.source: \x01@\x14 had the clan prepare its finest dishes, and laid them in a trail from \x01EH’s grave to a cave in the hills. When the hungry corpse gobbled the food all the way into the cave, \x01@\x14 sprang out and, with the help of some burly farmers, rolled a boulder across the entrance. \x01EH was trapped within.
candidates.translation: \x01@\x14让氏族备好最精美的菜肴，把它们从\x01EH的坟墓一路摆到山中的一处洞穴。那具饥饿的尸体一路狼吞虎咽，吃进洞里时，\x01@\x14跳了出来，在一些壮实农夫的帮助下，把一块巨石滚到洞口堵住。\x01EH被困在了里面。

candidates.source: Tell the family to tolerate \x01EH until he passes on.
candidates.translation: 告诉那家人容忍\x01EH，直到他自行离去。

candidates.source: The clan ring told the family to tolerate \x01EH until he passed on.
candidates.translation: 氏族议事会告诉这家人容忍\x01EH，直到他安息。

candidates.source: \x01EH’s family grumbled at the ring’s decision, but obeyed. For six more nights the revenant visited them, but on the seventh there was no knock at their door and no unwelcome guest.
candidates.translation: \x01EH的家人对议事会的决定满腹牢骚，但还是服从了。此后六个夜晚，亡魂仍来造访；可到了第七夜，他们家门口再没有敲门声，也没有不速之客。

candidates.source: \x01EH’s daughter-in-law thinks her barley stew finally satisfied him. But his granddaughter makes a face, and says \x01EH probably went in search of better cooking.
candidates.translation: \x01EH的儿媳认为自己的大麦炖菜终于让他满足了。可他的孙女做了个鬼脸，说\x01EH多半是去找更好吃的饭菜了。

candidates.source: We really do need to resolve this before \x01EH eats into our food reserves.
candidates.translation: 我们真得在\x01EH蚕食我们的食物储备之前把这事解决掉。

candidates.source: Should his family mourn \x01EH as dead, or feed their kin?
candidates.translation: 他的家人该把\x01EH当作死者来哀悼，还是该供养自己的亲人？

candidates.source: \x01EH is their kin.
candidates.translation: \x01EH是他们的亲人。

candidates.source: Several days later, \x01EH returned to his family and demanded another feast. When they told him there was no more mead and that he had eaten the last ham, he stomped off in disgust. He has not returned.
candidates.translation: 几天后，\x01EH回到家里，要求再摆一场宴席。他们告诉他蜂蜜酒已经没了，最后一条火腿也让他吃掉了，他便厌恶地跺着脚走了。此后再没回来。

candidates.source: After several more days of demanding porridge from his kin, \x01EH told them, “This clan’s hospitality is sorely lacking. I was given bronze to eat, and it does not sit well. I will find another clan that will treat an old man with respect.” With that, he shambled off.
candidates.translation: 又过了几天，\x01EH一直向亲人索要粥，然后对他们说：“这个氏族的待客之道差得离谱。竟拿青铜给我吃，我吃了很不舒服。我要另找一个敬重老人的氏族。”说完，他便拖着步子走了。

candidates.source: After several more days of calling for porridge, \x01EH told his family, “What has the \x01@" clan come to when his own kin try to disown an old man? I will find another clan that will treat pig tenders with respect.” With that, he shambled off.
candidates.translation: 又过了几天，\x01EH一直嚷着要粥，然后对家人说：“\x01@"氏族怎么落到这步田地，他自家的亲人竟想不认一个老人？我要另找一个敬重养猪人的氏族。”说完，他便拖着步子走了。

candidates.source: While the basic goal of KoDP is kingly victory, there are plenty of other goals. Achievements provide a way to track them (and share them with your friends). To enable achievements, you must log in to Game Center. You can do this when the game starts, or use the Game Center app before launching KoDP.

candidates.source: You’ll get a brief on-screen indication when you earn an achievement. You can review your achievements by tapping the trophy button in the Controls screen, or in the Game Center app. (You’ll need to be connected to the Internet.)

candidates.source: Starting a new game doesn’t reset your achievements — after all, you might want to win both as a Queen and a King. If you want to start over, you can clear all achievements from the Controls screen. Each player has their own achievements, so you could also log out using the Game Center app, and log in as a different player.
candidates.translation: 开始新游戏不会重置你的成就——毕竟，你可能想既以女王身份获胜，又以国王身份获胜。如果你想从头开始，可以从控制界面清空所有成就。每个玩家都有自己的成就，因此你也可以使用 Game Center 应用登出，再以其他玩家的身份登录。

candidates.source: It takes fifteen years for a baby to grow up, become initiated as an adult, and become a farmer or noble. At KoDP’s level of simulation, children play little role in the clan’s affairs. As a player, you’ll want to watch for the situation in which you have more children than farmers, since this puts you at greater risk of starvation.

candidates.source: The Bushel we use as the unit of food in KoDP is the amount of food it takes to feed one person for a year. A normal bushel is just a medium-sized basket, but our Bushel comes from the Godplane: these are Ernalda’s Bushels, and the Earth Mother’s basket holds enough to feed one of us little people for a year.

candidates.source: For simplicity, KoDP lumps cows, sheep, and pigs into one statistic. This is called “cows” or “cattle” because that’s the most important animal, but it reflects all three. Game crises may deal with sheep or pigs, in which case the aggregate “cow” value will change.
candidates.translation: 为简化起见，KoDP 把牛、羊和猪合并为一项统计数据。由于牛是最重要的牲畜，这项数据称为“牛”或“牛只”，但它反映的是三者总数。游戏中的危机可能涉及羊或猪，此时合并后的“牛”值也会随之变化。

Your mightiest leaders heroquest to the Godplane to perform the gods’ original mythic events anew, returning with gifts from the time of Creation.

candidates.source: KoDP uses Goods as an abstraction for desirable material resources that are over and above what the clan needs just to get by. Goods are always valuable items that the gods, neighboring clans, or enemy weaponthanes would be happy to possess. This abstraction lets you get by without tracking specific amounts of raw silver, finely worked silver, building materials, gemstones, fur capes, and so on. Your clan isn’t destitute when it runs out of goods; instead, your people possess only the minimum they need to get by, without any surplus available for the common use of the clan.
candidates.translation: KoDP以“货物”这一抽象概念来表示超出氏族维持生计所需、令人向往的物质资源。货物始终是神祇、邻近氏族或敌方武器武士都乐于占有的贵重物品。有了这种抽象表示，你无需逐一追踪未加工银、精制银器、建筑材料、宝石、毛皮斗篷等的具体数量。当货物耗尽时，你的氏族并不会一贫如洗；只是氏族人仅拥有维持生计所需的最低限度物资，没有任何剩余可供氏族共同使用。
